name: queens_guard_patches_armor
description: The Beekeeper's patch for Armored does patch it (M6 balance): a Queen's Guard sting of 50 ignores 3 armour, so it does 49 to a Thornback (armour 4) every 1.2 s, 40.8 a second, where the Royal Apiary's 34 does 30 every 0.8 s, 37.5 a second. At the design's 40 with no pierce it did 36, 30 a second: the fork for Armored was the weaker one against armour.

steps.assert: guard.branch == 1 and guard.dmg_c == 5000 and guard.pierce_c == 300 and guard.cd_t == 72
steps.msg: the Queen's Guard: 50 every 1.2 s, ignoring 3 armour
the Royal Apiary's 34 does 30 to a Thornback
against armour the patch out-damages the deepening: 40.8 a second against 37.5
